title: “The Future Is With Minhas Brothers”: Bashaar Syed After Arafat Minhas’ Performance Against England

 Bashaar Syed declared the Minhas brothers as the future of Pakistani cricket and also compared Arafat with the great Shahid Afridi and Abdul Razzak after his unbelievable performance against England in the last ODI game.
 by Chetan Phore | Oct 23, 2026 | 2 mins read Syed praised Arafat for his performance · Credits: Via PCB and YouTube Cricket The Pakistani brothers Nazar Syed and Bashaar Syed have opened up on the Minhas brothers and have declared them as the future of Pakistani cricket , after Arafat’s performance against England in the latest ODI game. Bashaar also stated that Arafat is already standing on the shoulders of the greats like Shahid Afridi and Abdul Razzak who hold the same record.
 Speaking alongside his brother Nazar Syed on their YouTube podcast named “Backward Point Cricket Podcast”, Bashaar elaborated on the brothers of Pakistani cricket. “I think, I think the future is with Minhas brothers and I think Pakistan cricket has the fans that are owed that you know we went through the brothers all three of them. Um, if you want to extend the Akmal family we went to then Babar Azam is also extended but that's probably a best case scenario for us. We went through a lot of brothers that should not have been in the Pakistan team that were in the Pakistan team and so the Minhas brother just seemed like a breath of fresh air and I welcomed it,” he said.
 Shahid Afridi managed it three times and Abdul Razzaq once, with Arafat Minhas joining an exclusive group of Pakistan greats with this rare feat less than 12 months out from #CWC27 😲

 “The kid comes out and takes six for 40 and scores 59 runs. Great knock, great bowling. It's completely bamboozled. He has already started standing on the shoulders of the giants like Shahid Afridi. What Afridi has done for Pakistan over the past two decades cannot be unseen. Minhas already has two fifers in ODI cricket to his name. He is on the cusp of doing that and Arafat Minhas finds himself in company with Abdul Razak, I think he will be fine,” Bashaar added.
 “Just to show how special Arafat Minhas's performance was. So taking a five wicket haul and scoring a 50 in an ODI has only been done 26 times in the history of ODI cricket and only two Pakistani cricketers have done this in the past. He's become the third one. The first one from a full member nation since Shakib Al Hasan scored 51 runs and took 5 wickets against Afghanistan in the 2019 ODI World Cup. Shahid Afridi the GOAT achieved this feat three times in his career,” Nazar Syed said while comparing Arafat with the great Shahid Afridi.
 Minhas’ Recent Iconic Performance
 Arafat Minhas’ recent performance was one of the greatest all round individual performances in the history of Pakistan cricket . He scored 59 runs and took 6 wickets for 40 runs against England in the ongoing tri-series and became only the third Pakistani cricketer in history. He leveled himself up to the Pakistani legends Shahid Afridi and Abdul Razzaq, who also have the similar record of scoring a half century and clinching a 5+ wicket haul in an ODI match. Earlier in May 2026, he broke a 41-year-old national record by picking up 5/32 on his ODI debut against Australia.
